Explicit RAM caller, not substituted firmware. Reproduce with v850-elf-as -mv850e3v5; v850-elf-ld -Ttext=0xFEBF8000; objcopy -O binary. Source:
/* RAM call-only continuation at FEBF8000 after real92836 returns. No lower
 * hardware completion, firmware replacement or callback replacement occurs. */
    .section .text.dcm_event_pending,"ax"
    .align 2
    .macro CALL target
    mov \target, r1
    jarl [r1], lp
    .endm
    /*32-byte observations: ring, notification, transport, callback, local session,
     * mode-request bitmap, programming-request latch and wrapper latch. */
    .macro SNAP_PENDING destination
    mov \destination, r12
    mov 0xfebe5e50, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 0[r12]
    ld.w 4[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 4[r12]
    mov 0xfebe5980, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 8[r12]
    mov 0xfebe5964, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 12[r12]
    mov 0xfebe5628, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 16[r12]
    mov 0xfebe5d54, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 20[r12]
    mov 0xfebeb098, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 24[r12]
    mov 0xfebe81ae, r1
    ld.bu 0[r1], r10
    st.b r10, 28[r12]
    mov 0xfebf3b19, r1
    ld.bu 0[r1], r10
    st.b r10, 29[r12]
    .endm
    /*24-byte observations: two timer slots, delay bits, OS nesting counter. */
    .macro SNAP_TIMERS destination
    mov \destination, r12
    mov 0xfebe5eac, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 0[r12]
    ld.w 4[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 4[r12]
    ld.w 8[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 8[r12]
    ld.w 12[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 12[r12]
    mov 0xfebe5dc8, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 16[r12]
    mov 0xfebe39dc, r1
    ld.w 0[r1], r10
    st.w r10, 20[r12]
    .endm
    /*Header and32 storage bytes, including the opaque trailing5E73 byte. */
    .macro SNAP_RING destination
    mov \destination, r12
    mov 0xfebe5e50, r1
    .irp off,0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32
    ld.w \off[r1], r10
    st.w r10, \off[r12]
    .endr
    .endm
    .global dcm_pending_after_real_confirmation
 dcm_pending_after_real_confirmation:
    SNAP_PENDING 0xfebf9000
    CALL 0x00098946
    SNAP_PENDING 0xfebf9020
    CALL 0x00098946
    SNAP_PENDING 0xfebf9040
    CALL 0x0009165e
    SNAP_PENDING 0xfebf9060
    CALL 0x00098946
    SNAP_PENDING 0xfebf9080

    /* Explicit software delay-state input; not a fabricated timer callback. */
    mov 0xfebe5dc8, r1
    mov 3, r10
    st.w r10, 0[r1]
    mov 7, r6
    mov 1, r7
    CALL 0x00098b3a
    mov 8, r6
    mov 0, r7
    CALL 0x00098b3a
    mov 8, r6
    CALL 0x00098b6a
    SNAP_TIMERS 0xfebf90a0
    CALL 0x00098ae4
    SNAP_TIMERS 0xfebf90c0
    CALL 0x00098ae4
    SNAP_TIMERS 0xfebf90e0

    /* Real counted-ring fullness; remove-all does not compact or free slots. */
    CALL 0x0009893a
    .rept 31
    mov 0, r6
    CALL 0x000989ec
    .endr
    SNAP_RING 0xfebf9100
    mov 6, r6
    mov 0, r7
    CALL 0x00098b3a
    CALL 0x00098ae4
    SNAP_RING 0xfebf9140
    CALL 0x00098946
    SNAP_RING 0xfebf9180
    .global dcm_pending_timers_generations_done
 dcm_pending_timers_generations_done:
    br dcm_pending_timers_generations_done
